findings.text: blocking: Review identity alone bypasses the review-related refusal, without resolving or checking a stored result produced by this reviewer before age-and-measurement checks return prune; an old ledgered reviewer whose delivered record is missing or unreadable is deleted just like a delivered reviewer, contrary to the plan's stored-review condition; keep the review-of-self exemption while checking its own delivered result and test absence.

non-blocking: The expected limit is the same default-valued argument extracted from the generated command and supplied to main; dropping main's limit assignment and using RETENTION_SWEEP_LIMIT leaves this assertion green, so it does not independently guard forwarding of the supplied bound; exercise a distinct positive limit for that claim.
